property_summary: For any admissible arguments, calling c.onERC721Received must return exactly the canonical selector bytes4(keccak256("onERC721Received(address,address,uint256,bytes)")); the mutant returns a different selector and therefore breaks this rule.
change_summary: Return a different bytes4 selector (keccak256 of a modified signature) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
